paper_title: A four-DNA methylation biomarker is a superior predictor of survival of patients with cutaneous melanoma
authors: Guo W, Zhu L, Zhu R, Chen Q, Wang Q, Chen J-Q
target_figure_description: ROC curve of the four-DNA methylation signature predicting overall survival in the TCGA training cohort. x = 1 - Specificity, y = Sensitivity; annotated AUC = 0.822 (95%CI 0.76-0.88), P < 0.001.
underlying_data: TCGA cutaneous melanoma cohort; the figure's own values are eLife Figure 2-source data 1 (training cohort, n=205): per-patient overall survival time, status, risk group and the four-DNA methylation score.
relationship_to_other_entry: Same paper as guo2019_melanoma_methylation (which recreates the KM curve, Figure 2C). This entry is a DISTINCT figure (Figure 2A) and a DISTINCT plot kind (ROC).
